doc.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Too many clients, prostate cancer scare and cutting back
summary: Managing ten or twelve people in the 1970s was too much, his son road-managed, he had early prostate cancer, and he reduced to Nancy Wilson, Joe Williams and Henry Johnson.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah. I needed somebody to take the phone, that’s right, that’s right. So it was building and all of a sudden I’m managing ten or twelve people, which is not, doesn’t make sense, because you can not do the job. I learned that quickly, you know, having that many people just wasn’t, didn’t make sense. I had a lot of help, I had different people working with me, but everybody depended on me for the decisions and they wanted to talk to me about anything. They wanted to talk to the Road Managers and everything. My son was working with me as a Road Manager. He went out with Ramsey for a while, then he was out with Wes Montgomery, and he was out with Stanley Turrentine, and Freddie Hubbard, and you know, so this was a time I had all these people. So I guess this is we’re talking now in the 70’s. And then I got sick, and I had, I was diagnosed as having prostate cancer. But it was in the very, very, very early stages, and I had an excellent doctor and that cleared that up. In other words I haven’t had any problems for me since then.

Although once a year I go and make sure — a check-up and all that. But it worked out fine for me. I was very fortunate. I had one of the top specialists in that field at the time. And then I decided this is too much pressure, all these people and I sort of cut back on it, and finally down to maybe three or four people. And now, at this point, two people which is Nancy Wilson and Joe Williams, and Henry Johnson, I work with because he’s with Joe and anything I can do to work with him is fine, and we’re very close. But that’s pretty much the story as far as —
